text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I heard this was great for body and mind...
and the rumors were true. Just walking here feels like
all my fatigue is melting away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By the mountain stream, I nodded at Ikuno Dictus's words as she narrowed her eyes.
When I spontaneously stretched...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ngh!!
Trainer, watch out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The stairs underfoot wobble unsteadily.
Ikuno Dictus catches me immediately, but—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Phew, thank goodness...
Are you hurt?
choice_data_list: A-Are you alri—...!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
? Is something the matter?
Is there something on my face—...?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ! M-My glasses... are gone?!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Guh... Is it dropped somewhere around here?
I apologize, my vision is somewhat poor right now...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I look around in a hurry,
but there are no glasses on the ground anywhere...
choice_data_list: Let's search around here some more!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Ah, sorry.
I didn't notice the step beneath my feet...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I-I will be careful next time.
I apologize for making you worry...!
choice_data_list: The footing is bad, give me your hand.
The footing is bad, give me your hand.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
B-But, I couldn't possibly
trouble you that much...
choice_data_list: Not at all! Safety comes first, anyway!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed.
In that case, excuse me. I'll borrow it...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I wondered if it might be on the other side...
but to think this is the only way across.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Poor visibility on top of this swaying.
To cross all the way over...
choice_data_list: Maybe we can cross if I carry you on my back.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Wh...?! W-Well, that may be true, but...
that's far too heavy a burden—
choice_data_list: A burden? Not at all, leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, you just sounded so reliable when you said that.
Well then, I'll take you up on that offer.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...I see, you have very good balance.
I take it you exercise on a regular basis."
choice_data_list: It's also for my training research.
It's also for my training research, okay?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
How passionate of you.
Please, let me come observe sometime.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together with Ikuno Dictus, who was getting
her energy back, we continued searching the area...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: âThe glasses were nowhere to be found.
choice_data_list: So just going in blindly won't work, huh...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Um, may I have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
We've searched the area and haven't found it.
In that case, it's possible it fell into the river.
Which means—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"As I thought, based on the river's flow, sediment tends to accumulate around here.
If the glasses fell into the river..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I strained my eyes to look where Ikuno Dictus was staring.
Then, near the bend of the river—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Sparkle*!)
choice_data_list: Found it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I dashed over immediately and waded into the river, shoes and all.
The familiar glasses were back...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—Field of vision is clear. Lenses are also intact.
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, your foot, please.
I'll wipe off the river water.
choice_data_list: I-I can wipe it myself!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Please let me do at least this much.
After all, thanks to you, I found my glasses.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there's a cut here.
I'm going to disinfect it, so please don't move.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...This should do it.
Thank you once again."
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to Ikuno pinpointing the location for us.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...No. I don't think I could have even
figured it out on my own.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Unstable footing, poor visibility...
It was a difficult situation to remain calm in.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"In the midst of all that, I was able to regain my composure...
because you took me by the hand."
choice_data_list: She was pretty flustered, for Ikuno.
She was pretty flustered, for Ikuno, wasn't she?
You're welcome!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"In the midst of all that, I was able to regain my composure...
because you took me by the hand."
choice_data_list: She was pretty flustered, for Ikuno.
She was pretty flustered, for Ikuno, wasn't she?
You're welcome!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Even I feel rushed when the time comes.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...I cannot say it won't happen again.
If that time comes... I apologize for the trouble, but...
choice_data_list: Leave it to me, no matter how many times!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calm and collected—those words described her perfectly.
Yet seeing her trust me enough to show her vulnerable side brought warmth to my heart.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Well then, I am fully prepared as well.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I'll carry you on my back on the way home, Trainer.
Your shoes are soaked from going into the river, aren't they?
choice_data_list: You really don't have to go that far for me...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It's fine.
We're here to help each other out... right?
